label: Accessory
description: Named eyewear, jewelry, bags, belts, neckwear, gloves, watches, hair accessories and handheld accessories.
notes: Accessories occupy their own slot, phrased as neutral noun phrases after with, without a prescribed color or outfit. clothing.headwear owns hats, tiaras and head coverings; person.hairstyle owns hair arrangements, while clips, hair ornaments and flower crowns belong here. person.body_art owns nose jewelry and other named body piercings; conventional earrings and removable ear cuffs belong here. Belt includes suspenders, neckwear includes pocket squares and shoulder wraps, and handheld covers umbrellas, fans, canes and muffs. Period accessories remain available in contemporary images; only the impossible visor and floating pendant carry genre restrictions.
